items.description: May be empty only when the request names remove_empty_directories or remove_empty_directory_trees (a folder-only closeout).

disposition.description: Classify before upload: preserve useful sources/results/evidence, discard proven disposable temporary files without upload, retain uncertain files without upload or deletion.

discard_intent.description: The classifier records disposal intent within delegated cleanup authority; not an additional approval-window requirement.

secret_values_kept_elsewhere.description: Only with role secret_config and disposition discard: the person confirmed that this file's secret values are kept elsewhere. A secret_config file is never uploaded.

remove_empty_directories.description: Exact directories removed only if completely empty after the file items; subfolders are not removed for them.

remove_empty_directory_trees.description: Exact directories inside the roots (a root itself is allowed). Every folder of the tree is bound at plan time and removed deepest first only if unchanged and empty. A folder holding a file, link or reparse point at any depth is kept with its parents. No file is uploaded, moved or deleted.
